description: Every Zammad ticket, article, and Knowledge Base operation as one agent-native CLI — plus a team-management layer (agent load, customer health, aging backlog, escalation triage, churn risk, feedback mining) the Zammad API can't answer in a single call.

tools.name: articles_by-ticket
tools.description: List all articles for a ticket. Required: ticket_id. Returns array of Article.

tools.name: articles_create
tools.description: Add an article (note or email) to a ticket. Required: ticket_id, body. Optional: type (default: note), internal (default: true), subject (plus 2 more). Returns the new Article.

tools.name: articles_get
tools.description: Get a single article by id. Required: id. Returns the Article.

tools.name: groups_get
tools.description: Get a group by id. Required: id. Returns the Group.

tools.name: groups_list
tools.description: List all groups. Returns array of Group.

tools.name: kb_answer-create
tools.description: Create a KB answer. Pass translations_attributes as JSON, then publish or mark internal. Required: kb_id, category_id. Optional: promoted (default: false), translations_attributes.

params.name: category_id
params.description: Category id the answer belongs to

params.name: promoted
params.description: Promote on the KB landing page

tools.name: kb_answer-delete
tools.description: Delete a KB answer (requires KB editor permission). Required: kb_id, id. Destructive.

tools.name: kb_answer-internal
tools.description: Mark a KB answer internal (agent-only). Required: kb_id, id.

tools.name: kb_answer-publish
tools.description: Publish a KB answer (make it public). Required: kb_id, id.

tools.name: kb_category-create
tools.description: Create a KB category. Pass translations_attributes as JSON. Required: kb_id. Optional: parent_id, category_icon (default: f115), translations_attributes.

params.name: parent_id
params.description: Parent category id, or empty for top-level

tools.name: kb_init
tools.description: Fetch the full Knowledge Base bundle (categories, answers, translations). Used by 'kb browse/search/get'.

tools.name: organizations_create
tools.description: Create an organization. Required: name. Optional: domain, shared (default: true), active (default: true) (plus 1 more). Returns the new Organization.

tools.name: organizations_get
tools.description: Get an organization by id. Required: id. Returns the Organization.

tools.name: organizations_list
tools.description: List organizations (paginated). Optional: page (default: 1), per_page (default: 100). Returns array of Organization.

tools.name: organizations_search
tools.description: Search organizations by name or custom field. Required: query. Optional: limit (default: 100). Returns array of Organization.

params.name: query
params.description: Search query, e.g. Acme or a custom-field query

tools.name: organizations_update
tools.description: Update an organization. Required: id. Optional: name, domain, active (plus 1 more). Returns the updated Organization.

tools.name: overviews_get
tools.description: Get an overview (and its tickets) by id. Required: id.

tools.name: overviews_list
tools.description: List all overviews.

tools.name: priorities_list
tools.description: List ticket priorities. Returns array of TicketPriority.

tools.name: states_list
tools.description: List ticket states. Returns array of TicketState.

tools.name: tags_add
tools.description: Add a tag to an object. Required: o_id, item. Optional: object (default: Ticket).

tools.name: tags_all
tools.description: List every tag defined in the instance (vocabulary).

tools.name: tags_list
tools.description: List tags on an object (defaults to a ticket). Required: o_id. Optional: object (default: Ticket).

tools.name: tags_remove
tools.description: Remove a tag from an object. Required: o_id, item. Optional: object (default: Ticket).

tools.name: tickets_create
tools.description: Create a ticket. Provide title, group, a customer, and an initial article. Required: title. Optional: group, customer_id, state_id (plus 4 more). Returns the new Ticket.

params.name: customer_id
params.description: Customer user id or email address

tools.name: tickets_delete
tools.description: Delete a ticket permanently (requires admin / delete permission). Required: id. Destructive.

tools.name: tickets_get
tools.description: Get a ticket by id. Required: id. Optional: expand (default: true). Returns the Ticket.

tools.name: tickets_list
tools.description: List tickets (paginated). Optional: page (default: 1), per_page (default: 100), expand (default: true). Returns array of Ticket.

params.name: expand
params.description: Expand referenced ids (state, priority, owner) into names

tools.name: tickets_search
tools.description: Search tickets with Zammad query syntax (e.g. 'state:open owner_id:3'). Optional: query, limit (default: 100), expand (default: true). Returns array of Ticket.

params.name: query
params.description: Zammad Elasticsearch query, e.g. state:open, category:billing, organization_id:5

params.name: expand
params.description: Return full ticket objects instead of ids+assets

tools.name: tickets_update
tools.description: Update a ticket (state, priority, owner, title, organization). Required: id. Optional: title, state_id, priority_id (plus 3 more). Returns the updated Ticket.

tools.name: users_create
tools.description: Create a user. Required: email. Optional: firstname, lastname, organization_id. Returns the new User.

tools.name: users_get
tools.description: Get a user by id. Required: id. Returns the User.

tools.name: users_list
tools.description: List users (paginated). Optional: page (default: 1), per_page (default: 100). Returns array of User.

tools.name: users_me
tools.description: Get the authenticated user (auth self-check). Returns the User.

tools.name: users_search
tools.description: Search users by email, name, or query (e.g. organization_id:5). Required: query. Optional: limit (default: 100). Returns array of User.

tools.name: users_update
tools.description: Update a user. Required: id. Optional: firstname, lastname, organization_id. Returns the updated User.

novel_features.name: Ticket volume by agent
novel_features.description: See each agent's current ticket load broken out by state (open/pending/backlog) so you can balance work before it piles up.

novel_features.name: Agent open/closed trend
novel_features.description: Show whether each agent's queue is growing or shrinking across the last N weeks, with opened-vs-closed deltas.

novel_features.name: Customer health indicators
novel_features.description: Rank organizations by a health signal built from open count, oldest-open age, reopen rate, velocity, and last activity.

novel_features.name: Tickets open too long
novel_features.description: Find aging tickets still in new/open/pending past a threshold, weighted by priority so the worst rise to the top.

novel_features.name: Escalation sentiment triage
novel_features.description: Surface active tickets whose recent customer messages read as upset (heuristic negative-signal scan), ranked by hits, age, and priority — with the matched snippets shown.

novel_features.name: Proactive churn risk
novel_features.description: Score each organization's churn risk from open backlog, overdue tickets, unanswered pending, and negative-sentiment customer messages, listing the contributing factors.

novel_features.name: Feedback mining
novel_features.description: Bucket ticket and article text into feature-request, pricing, compliance, and bug themes with the source ticket refs and snippets.

novel_features.name: Knowledge Base browse
novel_features.description: Print the Knowledge Base as a category/answer tree parsed from the init bundle.

novel_features.name: Knowledge Base search
novel_features.description: Offline text search over KB answer titles and bodies from the init bundle.

novel_features.name: Knowledge Base get answer
novel_features.description: Resolve a KB answer id from the init bundle to its full translated body.

novel_features.name: Add ticket note
novel_features.description: Add an internal or partner-visible note to a ticket in one line, with correct content-type defaults.
